query:
SELECT count(*) AS "total!",
                      count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.statut IN ('collecte','indisponible'))
                          AS "resolues!"
               FROM commandes.arret a
               JOIN commandes.segment s ON s.id = a.segment_id
               WHERE s.livraison_id = $1 AND a.type_arret = 'collecte'
